run_evaluate_response_generation: run response generation evaluation by computing BLEU scores between ground truth and model responses
run_evaluate_single_round: run single round evaluation on the last turn of dialogues for hidden split testing
run_compute_bleu_std_err: run BLEU score evaluation with standard error computation across all evaluated instances
run_record_instance_results: run evaluation and record per-instance BLEU scores and response lengths to a JSON file
run_normalize_sentence: run sentence normalization by lowercasing and tokenizing text into word tokens
